Name: teamLab Planets TOKYO
Notes: Walk barefoot through knee-deep water and a digital koi pond, plus the Floating Flower Garden with live orchids. More physical than Borderless. Extended to 2027; from ~¥3,800.

Name: Ghibli Museum, Mitaka
Notes: Advance tickets only. December tickets go on sale at 10am JST on Nov 10 (Nov 9, 5pm Pacific) via Lawson Ticket. ¥1,000; closed Tuesdays; no photos inside.

Name: Immersive Fort Tokyo
Notes: Indoor 'immersive theme park' with theater-style shows; 1-day pass from ~¥6,800 plus show fees. Most shows are in Japanese, so check for English-friendly ones.

Name: Arashiyama Hanatouro
Address (JA): ~京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺芒ノ馬場町
Notes: Ten nights of lantern-lit paths, from Togetsukyo Bridge through the Bamboo Grove to Nonomiya Shrine, along the river and up to Jojakko-ji and Nison-in: about 90 minutes on foot, free. Come between 5:30 and 7:30 on a weeknight for the best light and thinner crowds. Take the JR Sagano Line to Saga-Arashiyama (12 min), dress warm, and eat back in central Kyoto.

Name: Tenryu-ji
Address (JA): 京都府京都市右京区嵯峨天龍寺芒ノ馬場町68
Notes: Special night opening during Hanatouro, ~¥1,000. Lines build after 6pm, so go early.

Name: teamLab Botanical Garden Osaka
Address (JA): 大阪府大阪市東住吉区長居公園1-23 長居植物園
Notes: Permanent night-only artworks in a real botanical garden. It can be cancelled in bad weather, and December nights are cold, so dress warm.

Name: Nintendo Museum
Address (JA): 京都府宇治市小倉町神楽田56
Notes: On Nintendo's old Uji factory site: giant two-player controller games, a hanafuda (playing card) workshop, and 10 coins with each ¥3,300 ticket for the hands-on exhibits. Tickets go by lottery about three months ahead, entered with a free Nintendo Account and paid by credit card only; bring ID, which is checked on the day. December's main draw is over, so watch for cancellations, released about two months out.
